_comment: Stage 1 (P1): diffusion + I2V continuation, NO physics. Produces the shared base checkpoint P1 that both Stage-2 arms resume from. 256px both stages (methodology validation). k_steps=1 => single-random-sigma flow-matching diffusion (no unroll; the unroll is only needed for Stage-2 physics generation). Augmented clips (rot/trans/boost) feed the whole-clip DIFFUSION loss only (i2v_on_augmented=false) so the model learns to render those transformed scenarios; I2V continuation runs on the ORIGINAL clip only. LoRA rank 32 on q/k/v/out (locked across stages for resume compatibility).
